class.name: OcgPrs3dArrowaspect
class.brief_description: A framework for displaying arrows in representations of dimensions and relations.
class.description: ! A framework for displaying arrows in representations of dimensions and relations.

method.name: default
method.description: Constructs an empty framework for displaying arrows in representations of lengths. The lengths displayed are either on their own or in chamfers, fillets, diameters and radii.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Constructs a framework to display an arrow with a shaft of the length aLength and having a head with sides at the angle anAngle from each other.

method.name: SetAngle
method.description: defines the angle of the arrows.

method.name: Angle
method.description: returns the current value of the angle used when drawing an arrow.

method.name: SetLength
method.description: Defines the length of the arrows.

method.name: Length
method.description: Returns the current value of the length used when drawing an arrow.

method.name: SetZoomable
method.description: Turns usage of arrow zoomable on/off

method.name: IsZoomable
method.description: Returns TRUE when the Arrow Zoomable is on; TRUE by default.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
